name: review-maintain
description: Google Business Profile review operating system starter.

scripts.dev:web: node init && npm --workspace apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:api: node init && npm --workspace apps/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:worker: node init && npm --workspace apps/worker run start:dev
scripts.build: node init && npm-run-all --serial build:shared build:web build:api build:worker
scripts.build:shared: node init && npm --workspace packages/shared run build
scripts.build:web: node init && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.build:api: node init && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.build:worker: node init && npm --workspace apps/worker run build
